Alone in the Dark - The New Nightmare.name: Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare
Alone in the Dark - The New Nightmare.summary: The Game Boy Color version of Alone in the Dark: The New Nightmare received a relatively faithful adaptation of the home console game. The cartridge-based format necessitated the removal of the full-motion video cutscenes present in other versions, and many gameplay areas had to be reduced in size, with some eliminated entirely. However, the basic pre-rendered environments and the 3D characters imposed on top of them remain.

Army Men - Sarge's Heroes 2.name: Army Men: Sarge's Heroes 2
Army Men - Sarge's Heroes 2.summary: Sarge's Heroes 2 starts where Sarge's Heroes left off. It is announced that the capture of Field Marshal Tannenberg will end the war. Since General Plastro has disappeared, it is suggested that he has become a victim of plastrification and been trapped in the real world. The game introduces Bridgette Bleu, a spy for the Blue Nation. She has developed a serum that reverses plastrification. Your job as Sarge and sometimes Vikki is to destroy the serum, eliminate Tan soldiers, and capture Plastro and Tannenburg.

Driver - You Are the Wheelman.name: Driver
Driver - You Are the Wheelman.summary: Game Boy Color port of Driver.
